# Installation

JABBA3 depends on `RTMB` and `ggplot2`. NUTS needs `tmbstan` (and `rstan`); FLR
inputs and outputs need `FLCore` (and `ggplotFL` for plotting); `patchwork` is
used for multi-panel diagnostics. The converters from JABBA 2 need the `JABBA`
package.

```{r install, eval = FALSE}
install.packages(c("RTMB", "ggplot2", "Matrix", "tmbstan", "rstan", "patchwork"))
install.packages(c("FLCore", "ggplotFL"),
                 repos = c("https://flr.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
remotes::install_github("Henning-Winker/JABBA3@converters")
```

```{r load}
library(JABBA3)
packageVersion("JABBA3")
jabba3_info()
```
